property_summary: For any non-empty array of recipients with at least two elements or one element, transfer(..) should return true when the callee accepts, but the buggy version reverts on arrays with length != 1, so the rule 'a two-element array succeeds when each recipient accepts' is broken for a fuzzed two-element array.
change_summary: Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) check with one that requires a single-element array, so empty arrays and multi-element arrays revert.
